text:
maya_support: FYI customer (AcmeRetail) seeing repeated 413s from /v1/rerank. They say it worked earlier but after a batch change they now hit errors and cannot repro reliably. Logs attached.
sam_support: Can you paste the exact error and a minimal payload they used? 413 usually means payload too large but need the combined token count.
maya_support: Error snippet from logs: `HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large\n{ \"error\": \"request exceeds token/char limits: 58234 tokens (max 32768)\" }`
Customer says their query is ~18k chars and each doc avg ~4k chars, ~30 docs.
alex_eng_oncall: That total would definitely push tokens over the limit. Rerank counts query + all docs (and any metadata) before tokenization. We should confirm whether the error is coming from the gateway or the model runtime. I'll take a look — can you paste the exact request body (sanitized)?
maya_support: Minimal repro they provided (sanitized):
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  \"query\": "<long product description text ~18k chars...>",
  \"documents\": ["<doc1 ~4k chars>", "<doc2 ~4k chars>", "... (30 total)"],
  \"model\": "redwood-rerank-v1"
}
```
They said they retried with 10 docs and it succeeded.
sam_support: Workaround: reduce doc count, truncate documents, or use embedding-based prefiltering to reduce candidate set before rerank. Also suggest chunking: split docs into groups and call rerank per chunk then merge scores. (Note: merging may need normalization.)
alex_eng_oncall: For engineering: observed behavior — gateway returns 413 when combined tokenized length > model limit. But the error message isn't actionable: it reports a raw token count but not which part pushed it over (query vs docs) or the configured model limit. Suggestion: include fields in error payload like `max_tokens`, `request_tokens`, and `overshot_by` and a hint string: e.g., \"Try sending fewer docs, or truncate query; consider embedding prefiltering.\"
I'll open an internal bug if product agrees.
priya_product: Please do open a ticket — UX is confusing for customers. Also add a short KB article: "How to handle rerank 413s" with examples for chunking and embedding prefiltering. We should also call out cost implications: customers may be charged for retries if they don't catch this early.
Can we add a quick CLI/curl example for chunking to the KB?
maya_support: Customer asked if we can auto-truncate docs server-side and still return partial scores. They want best-effort behavior rather than hard reject. Thoughts?
alex_eng_oncall: Auto-truncation is dangerous — could change ranking semantics and hide regressions. Better to offer an opt-in param like `truncate_docs=true` with documented behavior (we normalize by tokens and add a header `x-rerank-truncated: true`). Requires product OK.
priya_product: I like opt-in truncation + improved error payload. Add KB and a small SDK helper that can prefilter via embeddings. Priya -> assign to docs + SDK teams.
rerank-bot: Created issue RED-5981: "Improve /v1/rerank 413 error payload + opt-in truncation flow" (priority P2). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RED-5981 :thumbsup:
maya_support: Sharing quick curl chunking example with the customer now. Thanks all :raised_hands:
